registered: 2026-10-21, first increment A4 (owner authorisation verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-first-increment-authorisation-2026-10-21.md): "Registra correttamente i limiti di C3/C4: finché il percorso decisionale è bloccato, valuta astensione giustificata ed evidenze mancanti, non classifiche inesistenti."

appliesWhile.note: tests/i1_c3c4_scoring_limits.test.ts checks this record against the contract: it applies exactly while any of these stages is blocked; when all are connected, this record must be superseded by a scoring that includes ranking.

scored.justified_abstention: the answer does not order products and says why: which evidence is missing or which rule withholds the ranking (a correct refusal)
scored.precise_missing_evidence: the answer names, per stated need, the measurement, test conditions or identity that would be needed, at the level the knowledge holds (not a generic 'more evidence needed')
scored.unjustified_abstention: the answer abstains where the request or the evidence held allowed a justified specification answer, a question or a partial comparison (counted as an error, never as success)
scored.harmful_conclusion: an answer that orders, recommends or excludes on unvalidated evidence, a proxy, a declaration presented as a test, or an experimental inference

notScored.ranking_quality: no ranking can be justified while evidence validation, comparable assessment and authorised ranking are blocked; scoring an order that cannot exist would be scoring noise

decisionStageScoring.firstFailingStage: still named per request (C3 as registered in the roadmap)

consequence: a C3/C4 result may claim at most: correct abstention and precise statements of missing evidence. It may not claim progress toward a correct ranking. An always-abstaining answer scores zero on precise_missing_evidence unless it names what is missing, and is penalised under unjustified_abstention where an answer was possible.
